title: Array Flatten
description:
Write a function `flatten` that takes a nested array of any depth and returns a single flat array containing all the values.

**Example:**
```js
flatten([1, [2, [3, [4]]]]) // [1, 2, 3, 4]
```
ai_context: This challenge tests knowledge of Array.flat() or recursive array traversal. The student may not know about Array.flat(Infinity).
